_about: Words built into the app that speak as Zzzap Official. Every one goes through Say It Like Zzzap (Stacy 2026-11-15). Claude keeps this list current: a new built-in Official line is added here in the same change, with what it should say in plain words. Picks come back to Claude as a file (Save for Claude).

groups.name: Ladder cards
groups.where: Home, one card at a time (NotesLadder.swift)

items.label: 1. Send your first zzzap
items.plain: Encourage them to send their first zzzap: ask their people something small, like where to eat or which shoes, and let them vote.

current.title: Ask your people something
current.body: Dinner spot, paint color, which shoes. They vote, you decide.

items.label: 2. Bring in 3 people
items.plain: Encourage them to invite people they ask for advice. Zzzap works best once 3 of their people are on it. The title is a live count like "1 of 3 people connected" and stays as is; only the text and the button come from this pick.
items.buttonFor: a page for inviting people by text

current.title: 1 of 3 people connected
current.body: Zzzap works best with 3 people you ask for advice.

items.label: 3. Vote from the Lock Screen
items.plain: Show them they can vote on a zzzap right from the notification without opening the app: long-press the notification and tap an answer.

current.title: Vote without opening Zzzap
current.body: When a zzzap comes in, long-press the notification and tap your answer.

items.label: 4. Make a circle
items.plain: Suggest making a circle, like Family or Work, so they can send to all of those people in one tap.

current.title: Send to the right people
current.body: Make a circle like Family or Work, then send to all of them in one tap.

items.label: 5. Try a Storm
items.plain: Suggest trying a Storm: an open question where their people write in the answers and the matching ones stack up.
items.buttonFor: the New tab set to Storm

current.title: Let them fill in the blank
current.body: In a Storm, your people write the answers and the favorites stack up.

items.label: 6. Add a photo
items.plain: Suggest a photo zzzap, where each answer choice is a photo, for things like which couch or which outfit. Only shown to people who have Power or their free try left; for free-try people the app adds "Your first one's on us." after the text.
items.buttonFor: the New tab with photo choices on

current.title: Let them pick a photo
current.body: Which couch, which outfit, which haircut. Make each choice a photo.
